findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy on HTML pages
findings.observed: No Content-Security-Policy header on 7 page route(s): /, /register, /bookings, /bookings/new, /bookings/:id, /bookings/:id/edit.

findings.title: Pages can be framed by other sites
findings.observed: No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors on 7 page route(s): /, /register, /bookings, /bookings/new, /bookings/:id, /bookings/:id/edit.

findings.title: R1 party size 0 accepted
findings.observed: The submission was accepted and saved: marker OHDEAC720F appears on /bookings.

findings.title: R2 spaces-only name accepted
findings.observed: The submission was accepted and saved: /bookings gained a record (4 → 5 rows).

findings.title: R4 cross-account check
findings.observed: A second, unrelated account opened /bookings/10 and saw the first account's private record (HTTP 200, marker OH4C2D76B5 present).

findings.title: R5 Book table covered on mobile
findings.observed: "Book table" cannot be pressed at 390x844 at any scroll position; it is covered by div "Autumn special: 10% off weekday dinners! Show this banner at".
